reviewNote: Read all four complete Elliott follow-ups twice. Checked his male, literary voice and informal player address; mystery, romance, sci-fi and default genre choices; every plot detail; train roles and secret engagement; symbiotic semi-telepathic lifeform and interstellar cabal; government surveyor and isolated mining settlement; shared help/profit joke. Every %book, quote, emphasis marker, #$b# break and $h/$l/$u token matches, with player gender avoided.

rows.source: I finished writing my book, and it ended up being a mystery novel! Remember when you told me you were into mystery?$h#$b#Behold, '%book', a thrilling tale of deception and intrigue!$u#$b#I -almost- feel like I should split the profits with you, considering how much help you gave me!$h
rows.translation: Dokončil jsem svou knihu a nakonec z ní vznikl detektivní román! Vzpomínáš, že tě baví záhady?$h#$b#Pohleď: „%book“, napínavý příběh o klamu a intrikách!$u#$b#-Skoro- mám pocit, že bych se s tebou měl rozdělit o zisk — tvá pomoc pro mě tolik znamenala!$h

rows.source: I finished writing my book, and it ended up being a romance novel! ...You told me once that you enjoyed the genre, and, well, I've also been able to draw some inspiration from real life experiences lately. $l#$b#Here it is, '%book'.
